verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Mintlify's core authoring workflow — editing content via the web editor or Git (mintlify-docs-1), local preview and validation via CLI (mintlify-docs-11, mintlify-probe-rt-5), and a central docs.json for site structure/branding (mintlify-docs-16) — implying Markdown/MDX-based page authoring, but no evidence explicitly documents the specific rich components (tabs, callouts, code groups, steps) or confirms these are usable without custom HTML. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or examples of the named MDX components (tabs, callouts, code groups, steps) and confirmation they require no custom HTML.
